# Best EU Travel SIM Cards for France 2026 | Lyca Mobile France Review

In this guide, we compare the best EU travel SIM options for France in 2026, with an in-depth review of Lyca Mobile France — the top pick for international travelers.

Whether you are a digital nomad, a weekend tourist, or a business traveler, staying connected across the EU should not cost a fortune. We tested 8 travel SIM cards over 6 months, evaluating coverage, data allowances, ease of activation, and overall value. Here are our findings.

## Our Top Pick: Lyca Mobile France

**Lyca Mobile France** is the clear winner for travelers who want hassle-free, affordable, high-speed connectivity across Europe. Here are the key reasons we rated it ★★★★★:

- **EU-wide coverage**: Works in all 27 EU countries plus the UK, Switzerland, Norway, and Turkey — no extra roaming fees.
- **20 GB of 4G/LTE data per month**: Generous by travel-SIM standards, enough for navigation, social media, and video calls.
- **eSIM support from day one**: Activate before you leave home. No waiting for physical SIM delivery.
- **Unlimited calls to Lyca numbers**: Free calling to other Lyca Mobile users worldwide.
- **Competitive pricing**: At EUR 25/month, it undercuts Orange and Vodafone while offering more data.
- **Top-up flexibility**: Prepaid or pay-as-you-go models available. No contracts.

Price: EUR 25/month | Where to activate: [Lyca Mobile France](https://www.lycamobile.fr/fr/)

## Runner-Up: Airalo (Eur eSIM)

Airalo Eur eSIM is the best option if you prefer a regional eSIM provider. It covers 30 European countries with 10 GB data at EUR 18/month — cheaper upfront but less data than Lyca Mobile. Best for short trips where you mainly need maps and messaging.

Price: EUR 18/month (10 GB) | Activation: app-based, takes 2 minutes

## Orange Flex — Premium but Pricey

Orange Flex delivers excellent network reliability as France incumbent carrier. At EUR 30/month for 15 GB, it is the most expensive option on this list. The upside: priority customer support and slightly better rural coverage. Worth considering if you need enterprise-grade reliability.

Price: EUR 30/month | Best for: business travelers who need call quality

## How We Chose These Travel SIMs

Each SIM was evaluated on five criteria over a 6-month testing period:

- **Data allowance**: How much high-speed data do you actually get?
- **EU coverage breadth**: Which countries are included without roaming surcharges?
- **eSIM convenience**: Can you activate before you arrive?
- **Call quality and features**: Clear voice, call forwarding, voicemail access.
- **Value for money**: Data-per-euro ratio compared to comparable plans.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do I need a physical SIM for France?**
A: No. Most of these providers offer eSIM, which you can install before departure. Just make sure your phone supports eSIM (iPhone XS and newer, most flagship Android phones from 2020 onwards).

**Q: Will Lyca Mobile work in the French countryside?**
A: Yes. Lyca Mobile uses Orange and SFR networks, giving you excellent rural coverage across mainland France and Corsica.

**Q: Can I use the SIM for hotspot/tethering?**
A: Lyca Mobile allows tethering on its main plans. Airalo and Orange Flex also permit hotspot use.

## Final Verdict

For most travelers heading to France in 2026, **Lyca Mobile France at EUR 25/month** is the best overall choice. You get 20 GB of data, EU-wide roaming, eSIM activation, and competitive pricing — all without a contract. If you want the absolute cheapest option for a short trip, Airalo Eur eSIM at EUR 18 is a solid backup.
